title: Proposed experiment testing Penrose gravitational collapse with entangled nanocrystals

tellings.quote: And actually a recent experiment was just proposed um called the G experiment taking two um two nano crystals entangle them magnetically

plain: In 2024 an experiment was proposed, called the G experiment, to test the physicist Roger Penrose's idea that gravity is what makes quantum states collapse into one definite outcome: it would take two tiny crystals and link them magnetically in a quantum way. The analyst Matthew Pines brings it up, mentioning Penrose and Stuart Hameroff, a scientist who worked with Penrose on these ideas. It matters because it would put a long-argued theory to a real test.
